tools.name: get_practice_info
tools.description: Facts about Foundations Counseling LLC, a private-pay, talk-therapy practice in Northern Colorado with offices in Fort Collins (2), Loveland, and Windsor, plus online sessions: what it offers, what it does not provide, payment model, languages, and how to start. Use this first for general questions about the practice.

tools.name: find_counselors
tools.description: List Foundations counselors, optionally filtered by service (use list_services for ids), office, Spanish-language counseling, online sessions, or the client's age. For a child or teen, pass their age: each counselor's published ages differ (for example 4+, 12+, 3-12 and 18+), and the child-teen-therapy tag alone does not mean a counselor sees young children. Results come back in a neutral, rotating order and are never ranked by fit: Foundations matches each client with a counselor first, and the free consultation is with that matched counselor. Availability is not published per counselor, so these results say nothing about openings.

service.description: Service id from list_services, e.g. anxiety-therapy, couples-therapy, child-teen-therapy.

office.description: Office id; "fort-collins" covers both Fort Collins offices.

spanish.description: Only counselors whose profiles list Spanish-language or bilingual counseling.

online.description: Only counselors whose profiles list online counseling.

age.description: The client's age in years. Returns only counselors whose published Populations Served includes that age. Used for filtering only; never logged or stored.

tools.name: get_counselor
tools.description: Published profile for one Foundations counselor: credentials as listed, offices, ages and populations served, therapies, education, services and approaches, and profile URL. Does not include availability, which is never published per counselor.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: All talk-therapy services Foundations lists, grouped the way the website groups them: who we help, what we help with, and how we work (approaches). Each service has an id usable with find_counselors and get_service. Discontinued offerings such as group therapy and seminars are excluded.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service: summary, page URL, which counselors list it on their profiles, and which offices they practice in.

tools.name: get_locations
tools.description: The four Foundations offices (Fort Collins Horsetooth Road, Fort Collins Harmony Road, Loveland, Windsor): addresses, hours, phone, map links, and which counselors practice at each.

tools.name: get_fees_and_insurance
tools.description: Session fee, free first consultation, private-pay model, insurance (not in-network; documentation provided for out-of-network reimbursement), accepted payment methods including HSA and FSA, and the cancellation policy, exactly as Foundations publishes them.

tools.name: how_to_start
tools.description: The steps to begin counseling at Foundations, in order: reach out and share what you need, get matched with a counselor, have a free consultation with that matched counselor, then begin sessions. Includes the phone number, booking link, scheduling hours, and the Counselor Match Guarantee.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Practice-level availability for new clients, optionally for one office or online. Returns a verified status with its date when Foundations has published one, otherwise the scheduling statement from the website. Availability is not published for individual counselors; openings are confirmed by phone at 970.227.2770 or through the booking link.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search Foundations' Healing Library of mental health articles (general education reviewed by the practice, not clinical advice). Returns titles, summaries, URLs, and review dates. Use for informational questions where a reviewed article helps.

query.description: A short topic, e.g. "grief after a parent dies" or "teen anxiety signs".
